send_message_to_user: send a message to a user by their user id with optional attachment from cloud drive
send_message_to_group: send a message to an existing group conversation with three or more participants
create_group_conversation: create a new group conversation with at least two other participants and an optional title
read_conversation_messages: read messages from a conversation with pagination and optional date range filtering
search_conversations: search conversations by participant names, title, and message content with optional date range
